2014_spells.misty-step.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.
2014_spells.misty-step.effectSummary: Teleport up to Self to a space you can see
2014_spells.misty-step.fullDescription: Using 1 bonus action, briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see. Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
